class.name: NNBTLimiter
class.brief_description: Limits how many total ticks its child can run before always returning [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE].
class.description: Allows its child to be ticked at most [member max_repeat_times] times across the node's lifetime, then returns [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] on all further ticks. Unlike [NNBTRepeater], the budget persists across runs and interrupts until [method NNBTNodes.reset] is called or the node is disabled and re-enabled. Use this to cap how many attempts an AI can make at a branch (such as trying to open a locked door at most 3 times).

members.member: Maximum total child ticks allowed before returning [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE]. Setting this property or resetting/disabling the node refills the budget.
